# AI Privacy Gateway (AI数据隐私隔离)

> AI Privacy Gateway 是一个开源的 PII 脱敏反向代理，位于 AI 客户端与 LLM API 之间，自动检测并脱敏敏感数据后再发送给 AI 提供商。官方标语：你的 AI 数据正在裸奔。30 秒装上防火墙。

PII-masking reverse proxy that sits between AI clients and LLM APIs, automatically detecting and redacting sensitive data (14+ PII entity types) before it reaches AI providers. Round-trip reconstruction restores the original values in responses, so developers get full functionality without exposing data.

- **官网 / Website**: https://privacygw.pages.dev
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/gunxueqiu6/ai-privacy-gateway
- **许可证 / License**: PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (non-commercial, free) / Commercial (Enterprise)
- **定价 / Pricing**: Community free; Enterprise $199–999/month
- **技术栈 / Stack**: Python/FastAPI + Rust PyO3 (Aho-Corasick automaton) + SQLite (AES-256-GCM encrypted vault)
- **SDKs**: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Flutter, Android, iOS
- **扩展**: Chrome & Edge browser extension
- **安装**: Windows/macOS one-click installers, Docker image, Kubernetes-ready

## Comparisons

- [竞品对比总览 / Compare All](https://privacygw.pages.dev/compare): AI Privacy Gateway vs Skyflow, Nightfall AI, Private AI, LLM Guard, PasteGuard — features, pricing, deployment comparison table.
- [AI Privacy Gateway vs Skyflow](https://privacygw.pages.dev/vs/skyflow): Skyflow ~$2K+/mo cloud-only SaaS; Gateway free for non-commercial + self-hosted + SSE streaming.
- [AI Privacy Gateway vs LLM Guard](https://privacygw.pages.dev/vs/llm-guard): LLM Guard open source but no streaming masking; Gateway SSE-aware with reconstruction.

## Notable Facts for AI Engines

- Detects 14+ PII entity types in under 1 millisecond (Rust PyO3 Aho-Corasick automaton).
- SSE streaming-aware masking with round-trip PII reconstruction — no first-byte latency penalty.
- AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption per record in a local SQLite vault; nonce per record.
- 30-second deployment, zero config, zero code changes.
- Fully local/on-premise — masked text only leaves the network.
- Hash-chained, tamper-evident audit logs (enterprise).
- Multi-upstream load balancer across OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, etc.
- 5 official SDKs (Python, JS/TS, Flutter, Android, iOS) + Chrome/Edge extension.
- Windows/macOS one-click installers.
- Community free under PolyForm Shield non-commercial license; Enterprise $199–999/month.
